articles.summary: ARCHBOLD, Ohio, Oct. 31, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- F&M Bank (“F&M”), an Archbold, Ohio-based bank owned by Farmers & Merchants Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: FMAO), is proud to announce the appointment of Amy Cover to Chief Marketing & Experience Officer (CMXO).
articles.title: F&M Bank Appoints Amy Cover as Chief Marketing & Experience Officer
